states.name: IDLE
states.quote: State: IDLE | Valve Command Pattern (V1,V2,V3): 0,0,0 | Definition / Exit Condition: All valves closed. A START edge begins FILL_T1. A SHUT command while already empty has no useful hydraulic effect and may be treated as completed shutdown.

states.name: FILL_T1
states.quote: State: FILL_T1 | Valve Command Pattern (V1,V2,V3): 1,0,0 | Definition / Exit Condition: Command XV-101 open. XV-102 and XV-103 closed. Transition when LT-101 >= T1_High.

states.name: WAIT_AFTER_FILL
states.quote: State: WAIT_AFTER_FILL | Valve Command Pattern (V1,V2,V3): 0,0,0 | Definition / Exit Condition: All valves closed. Hold for the configured post-fill wait. STOP freezes remaining time.

states.name: TRANSFER_T1_T2
states.quote: State: TRANSFER_T1_T2 | Valve Command Pattern (V1,V2,V3): 0,1,0 | Definition / Exit Condition: Command XV-102 open. V1 and V3 closed. Transition when LT-101 <= T1_Low.

states.name: WAIT_AFTER_TRANSFER
states.quote: State: WAIT_AFTER_TRANSFER | Valve Command Pattern (V1,V2,V3): 0,0,0 | Definition / Exit Condition: All valves closed. Hold for configured post-transfer wait. STOP freezes remaining time.

states.name: DRAIN_T2
states.quote: State: DRAIN_T2 | Valve Command Pattern (V1,V2,V3): 0,0,1 | Definition / Exit Condition: Command XV-103 open. V1 and V2 closed. Transition when LT-102 <= T2_Low.

states.name: WAIT_AFTER_DRAIN
states.quote: State: WAIT_AFTER_DRAIN | Valve Command Pattern (V1,V2,V3): 0,0,0 | Definition / Exit Condition: All valves closed. Hold for inter-cycle wait, then return to FILL_T1 automatically.

states.name: PAUSED
states.quote: State: PAUSED | Valve Command Pattern (V1,V2,V3): 0,0,0 | Definition / Exit Condition: All valves closed. Preserve the interrupted sequence state and, if applicable, its remaining timer. START resumes the stored state.

states.name: SHUTDOWN
states.quote: State: SHUTDOWN | Valve Command Pattern (V1,V2,V3): 0,1,1 | Definition / Exit Condition: V1 closed; V2 and V3 commanded open together. Remain in SHUTDOWN until both tanks are at or below their low-level limits, then close all valves and go to IDLE.

transitions.quote: From: IDLE | Trigger / Guard: START edge | To: FILL_T1 | Actions: V1=1 | Comment: new cycle
From: FILL_T1 | Trigger / Guard: LT-101 >= T1_High | To: WAIT_AFTER_FILL | Actions: V1=0; start timer
From: WAIT_AFTER_FILL | Trigger / Guard: timer expired | To: TRANSFER_T1_T2 | Actions: V2=1
From: TRANSFER_T1_T2 | Trigger / Guard: LT-101 <= T1_Low | To: WAIT_AFTER_TRANSFER | Actions: V2=0; start timer
From: WAIT_AFTER_TRANSFER | Trigger / Guard: timer expired | To: DRAIN_T2 | Actions: V3=1
From: DRAIN_T2 | Trigger / Guard: LT-102 <= T2_Low | To: WAIT_AFTER_DRAIN | Actions: V3=0; start timer
From: WAIT_AFTER_DRAIN | Trigger / Guard: timer expired | To: FILL_T1 | Actions: V1=1 | Comment: automatic repeat
